tips_for_faculty.title: Connect your LOs to evidence
tips_for_faculty.body: Review which ETS subcontent areas your mapped learning objectives support strongest. Small syllabus or rubric tweaks aligned to a growth area can be logged as a closing-the-loop action for next cycle.

tips_for_faculty.title: Use aggregate framing in conversations
tips_for_faculty.body: When discussing results with colleagues, keep student performance at program or cohort level unless IR has approved narrower sharing. The full site will enforce role-based views automatically.

tips_for_faculty.title: Document interventions (T2)
tips_for_faculty.body: When you change an assignment or unit to address a measured gap, note what was measured (T1), what you changed (T2), and plan the follow-up measure (T3). This feeds Table 5.1 style rollups for the college.
